title: Yeung Chow Fried Rice
description: We love a Chinese takeaway, but we don’t love how unhealthy they can be. This Yeung Chow Fried Rice tastes as good as the real thing but comes in at 400 calories per serving.

ingredients.text: 150g pork loin steaks, cut into strips
bunch of spring onions, trimmed and thinly sliced
1 carrot, peeled and coarsely grated or cut into thin strips (julienne)

steps:
Mix the marinade ingredients together in a bowl, add the pork loin strips
and mix until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes.

Cook the rice according to packet instructions, fluff up with a fork, then
allow to cool.

Heat a wok over a medium heat and scramble the egg. Place on a plate
and put to one side.

Wipe out the wok, spray with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a
high heat. Add the marinated pork strips and stir-fry for 5 minutes, until
the pork is cooked. Add the peas, onions, ham, carrot and prawns and
stir-fry for another minute.

Add the cooked rice, cooked egg and tablespoon of soy sauce. Continue
to stir-fry, until the ingredients are well combined and the rice is
thoroughly heated, then serve.
